- Added integrated email features: create mailboxes, send, receive, and manage email directly (including free @domani.run addresses).
- Updated description and usage examples to include both domain and email capabilities.
- Clarified which actions require authentication and which are public, reflecting new email endpoints.
- Changed metadata and icon to reflect new email features.
- Removed obsolete references to crypto payment documentation.

domani v1.0.0

- Initial release of the domani skill for domain infrastructure.
- Enables searching, registering, and managing domain names via the domani.run API.
- Supports checking domain availability, WHOIS lookup, DNS setup, Vercel and email connection, DNS record management, transfers, and renewals.
- Public endpoints (search, suggestions, WHOIS, TLD pricing) require no authentication.
- Authenticated actions (buy, configure, transfer, etc.) support card and USDC payments.
- Installation and setup instructions provided for major agent platforms (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Claude.ai, MCP).
